contexts.text: The external man is moveable in its relation to the internal.
This signified that he was versatile...

It was shown how versatile they were... so that all things were indeterminate. When one turned himself, he changed his mind, like a revolving wheel, into the opposite... A plane must be formed from the truths of faith... in the world; otherwise their state is versatile and evil.
No more moveable than a door without a hinge.
